summary: Callbacks can opt in to implicit internal tasks with self.wants_implicit_tasks = True and check each Task's .implicit attribute.
questions: How can my callback receive tasks Ansible generates internally?
How do I tell if a task was created by the user or by Ansible?

answer_card.title: Implicit tasks in callbacks
answer_card.answer_md: Set `self.wants_implicit_tasks = True`. Each `Task` passed to a hook has `.implicit`, telling you whether Ansible generated it or the user wrote it.
